title: Minecraft Java Edition raises recommended memory to 16GB ahead of Vulkan transition
excerpt: Mojang has updated the system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition, raising recommended system memory from 4GB to 16GB. The minimum is now 8GB with a dedicated GPU or 12GB with integrated graphics.
content_html:
Published: Today, 09:14 GMT WhyCry

Minecraft now requirpes 16GB system memory

Mojang has updated the system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition, raising recommended system memory from 4GB to 16GB. The minimum is now 8GB with a dedicated GPU or 12GB with integrated graphics. The recommended GPU tier starts with the GeForce RTX 2060, Radeon RX 5600 XT or Intel Arc A580.

The 16GB figure refers to total system memory, not memory allocated only to Minecraft. Java Edition now reserves 4GB by default, while the remaining capacity is used by the operating system, launcher, background software and integrated graphics.

The previous system requirements for Minecraft: Java Edition were based on older hardware and older graphics technology. While those specs may have reflected what Minecraft needed in the past, they no longer represent what the game needs to run well today.  

— Mojang

Java and other Editions

Minecraft has two main PC editions. Java Edition is the original Windows, Linux and macOS version with broad mod and custom server support. Bedrock Edition runs across PC, consoles and mobile devices, with cross-platform multiplayer and the separate RenderDragon graphics engine.

Java is receiving the larger requirements update because it still relies on OpenGL. Mojang added an experimental Vulkan renderer in Minecraft Java Edition 26.2, released on June 16, 2026. OpenGL remains available for now, but Mojang plans to remove it once Vulkan reaches the required stability and performance levels.

The Vulkan transition also prepares Java Edition for Vibrant Visuals. The graphics update is already available in Bedrock Edition and adds improved lighting, shadows, reflective water and volumetric effects. Mojang has not confirmed when the full feature set will arrive in Java Edition.

New Requirements

Mojang updated the Java Edition requirements on July 21, 2026. The new minimum target is 1080p at 30 FPS using the Fast preset. The recommended target is 1080p at 60 FPS using the Fancy preset.

content_html_zh:
发布时间： 今天 09:14 GMT WhyCry

Minecraft 现在需要 16GB 系统内存

Mojang 更新了 Minecraft: Java 版的系统要求，将推荐系统内存从 4GB 提高到 16GB。 现在，使用专用 GPU 的最低内存为 8GB，使用集成显卡的最低内存为 12GB。 推荐的 GPU 层从 GeForce RTX 2060、Radeon RX 5600 XT 或 Intel Arc A580 开始。

16GB 数字指的是总系统内存，而不是仅分配给 Minecraft 的内存。 Java版现在默认保留4GB，剩余容量供操作系统、启动器、后台软件和集成显卡使用。

Minecraft：Java 版以前的系统要求基于较旧的硬件和较旧的图形技术。 虽然这些规格可能反映了《我的世界》过去的需求，但它们不再代表游戏今天运行良好所需的规格。 ——Mojang

Java 和其他版本

《我的世界》有两个主要的 PC 版本。 Java 版是原始的 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 版本，具有广泛的 mod 和自定义服务器支持。 基岩版可跨 PC、游戏机和移动设备运行，具有跨平台多人游戏和独立的 RenderDragon 图形引擎。

Java 正在接收更大的需求更新，因为它仍然依赖于 OpenGL。 Mojang 在 2026 年 6 月 16 日发布的 Minecraft Java 版 26.2 中添加了一个实验性的 Vulkan 渲染器。 OpenGL 目前仍然可用，但 Mojang 计划在 Vulkan 达到所需的稳定性和性能水平后将其删除。

Vulkan 过渡还为 Java 版本准备了充满活力的视觉效果。 图形更新已在基岩版中提供，并添加了改进的照明、阴影、反射水和体积效果。 Mojang 尚未确认 Java 版何时会提供完整的功能集。

新要求

Mojang 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日更新了 Java 版要求。 使用“快速”预设时，新的最低目标是 1080p、30 FPS。 使用 Fancy 预设时，建议的目标是 1080p、60 FPS。
